name: upload
description: Save a file to Drive. Pass either file (an attachment) or text. Up to 25 MB. Drive allows several files with the same name, so uploading never replaces a file: pass replace_file_id to update one instead. With convert, the file becomes a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides, e.g. text or Markdown to a Doc, CSV to a Sheet.

text.description: Text to save as the file's content, instead of file.

name.description: File name, e.g. notes.md. Required with text, defaults to the attachment's name.

folder_id.description: Folder to save into. Default: the top of My Drive.

convert.description: Convert to a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides. Default false.

replace_file_id.description: Upload as a new version of this file, keeping its id, link and sharing.
